description: Prior authorization required but not obtained
next_step: Ask the provider to request retro-authorization or file an appeal with medical records.

description: Out-of-network provider not covered by plan
next_step: HMO plans cover out-of-network care only for emergencies. Member may appeal if no in-network provider was available.
Claim was received after the filing deadline. Provider may appeal only with proof of timely submission.
Same service was already processed. No action needed unless the service was performed twice.
Service is excluded in the plan's benefits summary. Member may appeal with a letter of medical necessity.

description: Additional information or medical records needed
next_step: Provider must send the requested records within 45 days or the claim stays denied.

description: Member not eligible on date of service
next_step: Coverage was not active. Verify eligibility dates and resubmit if coverage was active.
HMO members need a PCP referral before seeing a specialist. Provider can submit the referral and resubmit.
